projection.method: truncate first 512 dimensions, then L2 normalize
projection.comparison: sampled exact cosine neighbor overlap against the current 768-D vectors; 32 evenly spaced query chunks; excludes self

limitations: This is a mathematical projection challenger, not proof that an EmbeddingGemma native 512-dimensional representation is available or revision-qualified.
Neighbor overlap measures projection parity, not relevance or application quality.
Exact identity parity preserves chunk/page IDs, page content hashes, chunk checksums, and evidence revisions; it does not resolve canonical semantic writer ownership.
